Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. Quick checklist from our side: 

- We need a bank verification letter or voided check (either is fine) plus the signed ACH authorization (you included that).
- Please sign the ACH form via DocuSign so we have an audit trail: https://docusign.net/sign/XYZ123
- For security, AP requires either a bank letter or a voided check; can you attach the file to this thread or upload to the vendor portal ticket HS-3452?
- Confirm whether you want existing open POs to be reissued to the new remit, or only new POs after 5/19. If you want reissuance, AP will need finance approval (we'll loop them in).

Next steps from Redwood: once we have the bank verification and completed DocuSign, we'll open a portal ticket and run the standard micro-deposit / PO-test flow. I'll create the change request and tag AP for the update.

I'll also add Marcus from Finance so we can confirm any reissuance.

Best,
